conferenceTitle: 2026 International Engineering Conference, Exhibition and Annual General Meeting
theme: Engineering Innovation for Enhanced Security and Sustainable National Development
venue: The International Conference Centre, Maiduguri, Borno State, Nigeria
aboutSummary:
The Nigerian Society of Engineers (NSE) Conference is a flagship annual gathering that convenes engineers, policymakers, academics, and industry leaders to exchange knowledge, strengthen professional capacity, influence policy, and showcase innovative solutions. The conference serves as a strategic platform for advancing the engineering profession while addressing Nigeria’s critical development priorities.

This year’s edition is expected to attract over 10,000 delegates from across engineering disciplines, academia, manufacturing, government, and the private sector. The conference will feature keynote lectures, technical and panel sessions, exhibitions, and high-level networking opportunities.

Aligned with the theme, “Engineering Innovation for Enhanced Security and Sustainable National Development,” the conference will explore how emerging engineering innovations can strengthen national security architecture, drive resilient infrastructure, and support sustainable economic growth. Emphasis will be placed on leveraging technology, local ingenuity and multidisciplinary collaboration to enhance stability, improve infrastructure systems, and deliver long-term development outcomes for Nigeria.

scheduleOutline.summary: Arrival of delegates, accreditation, kit collection, fellowship conferment ceremony, and evening presidential cocktail.

scheduleOutline.title: Opening Ceremony – First Plenary Session
scheduleOutline.summary: Official opening ceremony, presidential address, exhibition launch, and first plenary session on national security innovations.

scheduleOutline.title: Second Plenary Session – Group Dynamics Competitions – Welfare Night – Cultural Night
scheduleOutline.summary: Second plenary on resilient infrastructure, innovation competitions, technical presentations, and the Borno Cultural Night.

scheduleOutline.title: Closing Ceremony – AGM – Annual Dinner – Gala Night
scheduleOutline.summary: Technical communiqué, official closing ceremony, NSE Annual General Meeting (AGM), and grand Annual Dinner & Gala Night.

scheduleOutline.title: Tour / Industrial Visit – Departures
scheduleOutline.summary: Engineering project tours across Maiduguri, spouses heritage visit, and airport shuttle transfers for departing delegates.

individual: On the landing page, choose the Individual Registration option
For Members, enter your Membership number to auto-load your details; for Non-Members, enter your details manually
Select either Physical or Virtual delegate mode
Optionally tick 'Include Spouse Details' if your spouse is attending
Click 'Add Delegate' and preview your details under the Delegate list on the right (edit if needed)
Choose your preferred payment processor (Paystack or Remita)
Click 'Pay and Submit'. Instant confirmation will be sent upon payment
group: On the landing page, choose the Group Registration option
Enter Group Details (Group Name, Address) and nominate the primary contact person
Add delegates by membership number or delegate details
Review the consolidated list and verify fees
Choose preferred payment processor (Paystack or Remita) and submit
Instant confirmation and receipts issued to group coordinator and delegates
